title: Emergency Family Scam
scenario: A caller claims your relative abroad is in trouble and asks you not to tell anyone.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.C: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Emergency Family Scam: the trap is to turn familiarity or emotion into compliance. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Secrecy plus urgency is a major manipulation sign.
